mapper.select: SELECT u.id as id, u.address as address, u.avatar as avatar, u.dob as dob, u.email as email, u.gender as gender, u.name as name, u.password as password, u.phone_number as phoneNumber, r.id as roleId, r.name as roleName FROM user u LEFT JOIN user_role ur ON u.id = ur.user_id LEFT JOIN role r ON ur.role_id = r.id WHERE u.email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(address, dob, email, gender, name, password, phone_number) VALUES (#{userInfo.address}, #{userInfo.dob}, #{userInfo.email}, #{userInfo.gender}, #{userInfo.name}, #{userInfo.password}, #{userInfo.phoneNumber})
